yovoice

Give your words a voice. Compose your ideas into songs.

English · 简体中文

Website · CLI & Agent Skill · API / MCP Deployment · Development

--- yovoice is an open-source, local-first audio and music creation studio for macOS, Windows and Linux. Turn text into expressive speech, natural cloned voices, complete vocal songs, and multi-track scores right on your machine. Featuring zero-shot voice cloning, emotional performance controls, AI music generation with lyrics, and General MIDI score arranging—**all running 100% locally with zero cloud API calls, zero per-character fees, and zero Python environment headaches.** ![yovoice creation workspace — browser preview](docs/images/yovoice-workspace.png) --- ## Why yovoice? - 🔒 **100% Local Privacy**: Runs entirely on your local GPU/CPU. Your manuscripts, reference voices, and creations never leave your computer. - 💸 **Zero Recurring Fees**: Say goodbye to per-character/per-minute meters and expensive cloud voice/music subscriptions. - ⚡ **Native C++ Performance (No Python Hell)**: Powered by [audio.cpp](https://github.com/0xShug0/audio.cpp) v0.9.1. Ships with bundled Windows CUDA 12.4/13.3 runtimes and native macOS Metal support. Double-click and create—no Conda or PyTorch conflicts. - 🎛️ **Creator Workstation**: Multi-take versioning for side-by-side comparison, waveform trimming, timeline scrolling, and clean stems/MIDI export. - 🤖 **MCP & AI Agent Ecosystem**: Chat with DeepSeek, Qwen, Claude, OpenAI, or local Ollama to create and edit works end to end. Includes a native Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Cursor and Claude Code. --- ## Features - **Speech, voice design and cloning** — clone a reference voice, design a voice from a description, adjust emotion and delivery, and edit takes on a timeline. - **Story dubbing** — import text or subtitle files, assign a character to each line, and generate line by line. - **Music** — write a style and lyrics with section markers, then generate songs or instrumentals with ACE-Step 1.5, or songs and score-based instrumentals with YuE2; the playback page syncs lyrics to the vocals. - **Score** — write parts by bar and beat, import MIDI or let an Agent compose, render with a General MIDI sound font, and export MIDI and stems. See [Score](docs/score.md). - **Optional AI service** — the built-in assistant panel chats with DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama or any compatible API and acts on your works: it writes arrangements and lyrics, edits text, assigns voices and starts generation; keys stay on this computer. See [AI service](docs/ai.md). - **12 interface languages** — English, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 日本語, 한국어, Español, Français, Deutsch, Português (Brasil), Русский, Italiano and Tiếng Việt; switch anytime in Settings, no restart needed. --- ## Supported Models | Use | Models | | --- | --- | | Voice cloning and emotion | IndexTTS 2.0 / 2.5, Qwen3-TTS Base | | Voice design and cloning | VoxCPM2, OmniVoice, Qwen3-TTS VoiceDesign, Breeze TTS 2 | | Built-in voices | Kokoro-82M, Qwen3-TTS CustomVoice | | Songs and instrumentals | ACE-Step 1.5 Turbo / XL Turbo, YuE2 3B | All models are downloaded inside the App or with the CLI. See [model selection](docs/models.md) for file sizes, hardware requirements, inputs and examples. OmniVoice, YuE2 and Breeze TTS 2 weights are restricted to non-commercial use. --- ## Installation Choose the package for your platform from the repository’s [Releases](../../releases) tab or visit the [official website](https://yovoice.leemysw.com). | Platform | Package | Install | | --- | --- | --- | | macOS 14+ · Apple Silicon | `.dmg` | Open the disk image and drag yovoice to Applications | | Windows 10/11 · x64 | `-setup.exe` | Run the installer, then open yovoice from the Start menu | | Windows 10/11 · x64 · NVIDIA GPU | `-cuda12.4-setup.exe` | Bundles the CUDA 12.4 runtime; works with older GPUs and drivers and uses the GPU from first launch | | Windows 10/11 · x64 · NVIDIA GPU | `-cuda13.3-setup.exe` | Bundles the CUDA 13.3 runtime; needs a newer driver, smaller download | | Linux · x64 (Debian/Ubuntu) | `-linux-x64.deb` | `sudo apt install ./yovoice--linux-x64.deb`, then open yovoice from the application menu | | Linux · x64 (other distributions) | `-linux-x64.tar.gz` | Extract and run `./install.sh` to add yovoice to the application menu for the current user | The Windows installer downloads and installs [WebView2 Runtime](https://developer.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge/webview2/) if needed. Models are downloaded inside the app; uninstalling preserves user data in `~/.yovoice`. On Linux the app needs WebKitGTK 4.1 (`libwebkit2gtk-4.1-0` on Debian/Ubuntu, `webkit2gtk4.1` on Fedora, `webkit2gtk-4.1` on Arch); the `.deb` installs it automatically. Linux runs on the CPU out of the box, and a Vulkan GPU runtime can be downloaded in Settings → Inference engine. The Linux app doesn't update itself yet; download new versions from Releases. Check for updates from the app menu on macOS or Windows. Updates are also checked and downloaded in the background; restart to install when ready. Windows updates download only the app (`-update.exe`) and keep the installed runtime; when a release recommends a newer runtime you can upgrade it in Settings → Inference engine. --- ## Quick Start 1. **Set up a model.** Download a model in Settings (e.g. Kokoro-82M for fast narration, or VoxCPM2 for cloning). 2. **Create a project.** Choose Story dubbing, Speech generation, Music, or Score. 3. **Add content.** Enter text, lyrics, or notes, then pick a character and adjust style. 4. **Generate audio.** Select Generate, then preview, compare takes, edit, and export. --- ## CLI & Agent Skill Give your agent the [yovoice Skill](https://github.com/leemysw/yovoice/tree/main/skills/yovoice) link and ask it to install the Skill and set up the local CLI, engine, and model: > Install this Skill and set up yovoice for local speech generation: https://github.com/leemysw/yovoice/tree/main/skills/yovoice Then describe what you want: > Read narration.txt using voice.wav as the reference voice, with a calm delivery, and save it as narration.wav. The agent runs the standalone CLI without opening the desktop app. See the [CLI guide](docs/cli.md) for details. --- Run `yovoice serve` to provide an authenticated HTTP API and MCP inference service for other machines. See the [API / MCP deployment guide](docs/api.md) for deployment and client examples. ## Development ```sh make install make app-run ``` See the [development guide](docs/development.md) for prerequisites. It also covers browser preview, tests, and project structure. For how the processes and packages fit together, see [Architecture](docs/architecture.md). --- ## Community Scan the QR code with WeChat to join the yovoice user group. If the code has expired, open an [issue](../../issues) and we will post a new one.

--- ## Contributing Bug reports, feature suggestions, and pull requests are welcome. Include your platform, model, and steps to reproduce when reporting a problem. Run `make check` before submitting code changes. --- ## Acknowledgements - [audio.cpp](https://github.com/0xShug0/audio.cpp) by ShugoAI — the local audio inference engine. - [VoxCPM](https://github.com/OpenBMB/VoxCPM) — voice design and cloning models, licensed under Apache-2.0. - [IndexTTS](https://github.com/index-tts/index-tts) — the speech synthesis models behind yovoice. - [OmniVoice](https://github.com/k2-fsa/OmniVoice) — voice design and cloning models. - [Qwen3-TTS](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-TTS) — voice cloning, built-in voices, and text-guided voice design. - [ACE-Step](https://github.com/ace-step/ACE-Step-1.5) — music generation from style prompts and lyrics. - [YuE](https://github.com/multimodal-art-projection/YuE) — full vocal song generation from lyrics. - [Breeze TTS 2](https://huggingface.co/BreezeBlue/Breeze-TTS-2) — Chinese and English voice design and cloning. - [go-meltysynth](https://github.com/sinshu/go-meltysynth), [MuseScore General](https://musescore.org/en/handbook/3/soundfonts-and-sfz-files#gm_soundfonts), [GeneralUser GS](https://www.schristiancollins.com/generaluser) and SGM-V2.01 by David Shan — the SoundFont synthesizer and sound fonts behind score rendering. - Kokoro — lightweight speech synthesis with built-in voices: [Kokoro-82M](https://huggingface.co/hexgrad/Kokoro-82M) and [Kokoro-82M-v1.1-zh](https://huggingface.co/hexgrad/Kokoro-82M-v1.1-zh). --- ## Star History --- ## License [Apache-2.0](LICENSE). Dependencies retain their [original licenses](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md); IndexTTS models are covered separately by their [model license](web/public/model-license.txt).

yovoice

把文字，变成有情绪的声音

English · 简体中文

官方网站 · CLI 与 Agent Skill · API / MCP 部署 · 开发指南

--- yovoice 是一款适用于 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 的开源、本地优先（Local-first）声音与音乐创作工作台。 在本地将文字转化为自然逼真的语音、整首带人声歌曲或多轨乐谱。支持零样本音色克隆、情绪风格控制、带歌词人声的 AI 音乐生成、多轨 MIDI 编曲渲染与音频工程管理。**完全在本地运行，无云端 API 调用，无按字/按秒扣费开销，无需复杂的 Python 环境配置**，让旁白、配音、有声内容与音乐创作更自主、更私密、更低成本。 ![yovoice 创作工作台，浏览器预览](docs/images/yovoice-workspace.png) --- ## 为什么选择 yovoice？ - 🔒 **100% 本地离线与数据隐私**：所有模型均在本地显卡/CPU 推理，文本稿件和声音样本永远不会上传到第三方云端。 - 💸 **零按字/按秒扣费**：无需订阅昂贵的云端 API（告别 ElevenLabs、Suno、商用配音会员计费）。 - ⚡ **原生 C++ 极速引擎，免配 Python**：基于 [audio.cpp](https://github.com/0xShug0/audio.cpp) v0.9.1 原生构建，支持 macOS Metal 与 Windows NVIDIA CUDA 12.4/13.3 开箱即用，告别 Conda 与 PyTorch 依赖地狱。 - 🎛️ **全流程专业创作流**：多版本试听对比（Takes）、多轨时间轴吸附裁剪、General MIDI 音色库本地渲染与分轨导出（Stems）。 - 🤖 **原生 MCP 与 AI Agent 协创**：接入 DeepSeek、通义千问、Claude、OpenAI 或本地 Ollama，用对话完成写歌写谱到生成的全流程，并提供 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 服务，支持在 Cursor 或 Claude Code 中直接调用。 --- ## 功能 - **语音、声音设计与克隆** — 克隆参考音色、用文字设计声音、调整情绪与演绎，并在音轨上剪辑各个版本。 - **故事配音** — 导入文本或字幕文件，为每句台词分配角色并逐句生成。 - **音乐生成** — 写下风格和带段落标记的歌词，用 ACE-Step 1.5 生成歌曲或纯音乐，或用 YuE2 生成歌曲和按谱演奏的纯音乐；播放页按人声同步歌词。 - **编曲** — 按小节和拍写声部，或导入 MIDI、交给 Agent 写谱，用 General MIDI 音色库渲染，导出 MIDI 和分轨。详见[编曲](docs/score_zh.md)。 - **可选 AI 服务** — 内置助手面板通过 DeepSeek、通义千问、Kimi、OpenAI、Anthropic、Ollama 或任意兼容接口对话创作：写谱写词、改台词、配音色、发起生成；密钥只保存在本机。详见[AI 服务](docs/ai_zh.md)。 - **12 种界面语言** — 简体中文、繁體中文、English、日本語、한국어、Español、Français、Deutsch、Português (Brasil)、Русский、Italiano 和 Tiếng Việt，可在设置中随时切换，无需重启。 --- ## 支持模型 | 用途 | 模型 | | --- | --- | | 音色克隆与情绪控制 | IndexTTS 2.0 / 2.5、Qwen3-TTS Base | | 声音设计与克隆 | VoxCPM2、OmniVoice、Qwen3-TTS VoiceDesign、Breeze TTS 2 | | 内置音色 | Kokoro-82M、Qwen3-TTS CustomVoice | | 歌曲与纯音乐 | ACE-Step 1.5 Turbo / XL Turbo、YuE2 3B | 所有模型都在 App 内或通过 CLI 下载。文件大小、硬件要求、输入要求与示例见[模型选择](docs/models_zh.md)。OmniVoice、YuE2 和 Breeze TTS 2 的权重仅限非商业用途。 --- ## 安装 在仓库的 [Releases](../../releases) 页面选择对应平台的安装包，或访问[官方网站](https://yovoice.leemysw.com)。 | 平台 | 安装包 | 安装方式 | | --- | --- | --- | | macOS 14+ · Apple Silicon | `.dmg` | 打开磁盘映像，将 yovoice 拖入 Applications | | Windows 10/11 · x64 | `-setup.exe` | 运行安装向导，安装后从开始菜单打开 | | Windows 10/11 · x64 · NVIDIA 显卡 | `-cuda12.4-setup.exe` | 内置 CUDA 12.4 内核，兼容较旧的显卡与驱动，首次启动即用 GPU | | Windows 10/11 · x64 · NVIDIA 显卡 | `-cuda13.3-setup.exe` | 内置 CUDA 13.3 内核，需要较新的驱动，安装包更小 | | Linux · x64（Debian/Ubuntu） | `-linux-x64.deb` | `sudo apt install ./yovoice-<版本>-linux-x64.deb`，安装后从应用菜单打开 | | Linux · x64（其他发行版） | `-linux-x64.tar.gz` | 解压后运行 `./install.sh`，为当前用户添加到应用菜单 | Windows 安装器会在缺少时联网安装 [WebView2 Runtime](https://developer.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge/webview2/)。模型在应用内下载。卸载应用保留 `~/.yovoice` 中的作品和模型。 Linux 版需要 WebKitGTK 4.1（Debian/Ubuntu 为 `libwebkit2gtk-4.1-0`，Fedora 为 `webkit2gtk4.1`，Arch 为 `webkit2gtk-4.1`），`.deb` 会自动安装。Linux 开箱使用 CPU，可在 设置 → 推理引擎 中下载 Vulkan GPU 内核。Linux 版暂不支持自动更新，请从 Releases 下载新版本。 macOS 和 Windows 均支持在应用菜单中检查更新，也会自动检查并后台下载；下载完成后可选择重启安装。Windows 自动更新只下载应用本体（`-update.exe`），保留已安装的内核；新版本推荐更高的内核时，可在 设置 → 推理引擎 中选择升级。 --- ## 快速上手 1. **准备模型。** 在设置中下载所需模型（例如轻量朗读用 Kokoro-82M，声音克隆用 VoxCPM2）。 2. **新建作品。** 选择“故事配音”、“语音生成”、“音乐生成”或“编曲”。 3. **填写内容。** 输入文字、歌词或音符，选择角色并调整风格。 4. **生成音频。** 点击“生成”，试听对比多版本（Takes）、编辑并导出。 --- ## CLI 与 Agent Skill 将 [yovoice Skill](https://github.com/leemysw/yovoice/tree/main/skills/yovoice) 链接发给 Agent，让它安装 Skill，并准备本地 CLI、引擎和模型： > 安装这个 Skill，并帮我配置好 yovoice 本地语音生成环境：https://github.com/leemysw/yovoice/tree/main/skills/yovoice 之后直接描述需求： > 用 voice.wav 的音色朗读 narration.txt，语气平静，保存为 narration.wav。 Agent 通过独立 CLI 完成配音，无需打开桌面应用。详细用法见 [CLI 指南](docs/cli_zh.md)。 --- 运行 `yovoice serve` 可为其他机器提供带认证的 HTTP API 与 MCP 推理服务，支持上传参考音频与生成 WAV。部署和调用示例见[API / MCP 部署指南](docs/api_zh.md)。 ## 开发 ```sh make install make app-run ``` 环境要求见[开发指南](docs/development_zh.md)，其中也介绍了浏览器预览、测试和项目结构。进程与各包如何协作见[架构](docs/architecture_zh.md)。 --- ## 交流群 使用微信扫码加入 yovoice 用户交流群。二维码过期时，欢迎提交 [Issue](../../issues)，我们会及时更新。

--- ## 参与贡献 欢迎提交问题、功能建议和 Pull Request。报告问题时，请附上操作系统、模型及复现步骤；提交代码前运行 `make check`。 --- ## 鸣谢 - [audio.cpp](https://github.com/0xShug0/audio.cpp) — ShugoAI 开发的本地音频推理引擎。 - [VoxCPM](https://github.com/OpenBMB/VoxCPM) — 声音设计与克隆模型，Apache-2.0 许可。 - [IndexTTS](https://github.com/index-tts/index-tts) — 为 yovoice 提供语音合成模型。 - [OmniVoice](https://github.com/k2-fsa/OmniVoice) — 声音设计与音色克隆模型。 - [Qwen3-TTS](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-TTS) — 支持音色克隆、内置音色与文字设计声音。 - [ACE-Step](https://github.com/ace-step/ACE-Step-1.5) — 根据风格描述与歌词生成音乐。 - [YuE](https://github.com/multimodal-art-projection/YuE) — 根据歌词生成整首带人声歌曲。 - [Breeze TTS 2](https://huggingface.co/BreezeBlue/Breeze-TTS-2) — 中英文声音设计与音色克隆。 - [go-meltysynth](https://github.com/sinshu/go-meltysynth)、[MuseScore General](https://musescore.org/en/handbook/3/soundfonts-and-sfz-files#gm_soundfonts)、[GeneralUser GS](https://www.schristiancollins.com/generaluser) 与 David Shan 的 SGM-V2.01 — 编曲渲染使用的 SoundFont 合成器与音色库。 - Kokoro — 使用内置音色的轻量语音合成模型：[Kokoro-82M](https://huggingface.co/hexgrad/Kokoro-82M) 与 [Kokoro-82M-v1.1-zh](https://huggingface.co/hexgrad/Kokoro-82M-v1.1-zh)。 --- ## Star History --- ## 开源协议 [Apache-2.0](LICENSE)。依赖组件保留[各自的许可证](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)，IndexTTS 模型单独遵循其[模型使用许可协议](web/public/model-license.txt)。
